title: Cellular Respiration - Aerobic vs Anaerobic
body:
Study the comparison diagram below:

```
[AEROBIC vs ANAEROBIC RESPIRATION]

                    GLUCOSE
                       |
                       v
                  GLYCOLYSIS
                  (2 ATP + 2 Pyruvate)
                       |
          +------------+------------+
          |                         |
     [O2 present]             [No O2]
          |                         |
          v                         v
    AEROBIC                   ANAEROBIC
    (Mitochondria)            (Cytoplasm)
          |                         |
          v                         v
    Krebs + ETC               FERMENTATION
    = 36-38 ATP               = 2 ATP only
          |                         |
          v                         v
    CO2 + H2O              Lactic acid (animals)
                           OR Ethanol + CO2 (yeast)
```

An athlete sprinting in a 100m race experiences muscle fatigue and cramping. Explain the type of respiration occurring and why this happens.
